meta.name: Highways of India (simplified polylines)
meta.limitations: Natural Earth has no road numbers for India and shows only the main trunk corridors; the expressway class is Natural Earth's own flag (Major Highway) and is not verified against NHAI; National Highway numbers are not available in this file. OSM via Overpass was tried and was too slow or overloaded to finish. Lines are simplified (0.01 degrees) and merged. A row is a chain of segments, not an official NH route.
meta.method: Natural Earth roads: type Major Highway (carries the Natural Earth expressway flag = 1) becomes category expressway; type Road with scalerank 3-4 becomes trunk_road (the main national highway corridors). Other classes (Unknown, scalerank 5 and higher) are dropped. Clip to India, merge touching segments (shapely linemerge), simplify with tolerance 0.01 degrees, drop chains shorter than 5 km, round to 3 decimals.
